section.title: Introduction
section.p: This area contains articles and presentations about the applications and frameworks hosted on this site. These articles provides background information and in depth discussions.

The first set of documents describe the capabilities and design of the pmMDA application. The second set of articles explains the concepts and trade-offs of the distributed frameworks. The third set of stories shows war stories and lessons learned.
